text: core-utils failed on this round's new regression test: it used a 150ms absolute budget calibrated on a quiet machine, and the shared CI runner hit 233.5ms even on the fixed code. text: checked the P1 before changing anything. a team deployment is indexed under its own internal model_name and its public team name lives in a separate index, so resolving a group through the model_name index cant reach another teams ids. ran the same probe on base and on this branch. the plain model name gives ['shared-1'] on both. the group name gives [] on base and ['shared-1'] here. so team scope was already not consulted at that call site and this doesnt change it, it only stops the group name resolving to nothing. pushed a test pinning that, plus the docstring reword.
